comment: The contract for a chain that continues from an archived prefix. Rotation (src/infra/storage/chain-rotation.ts) archives the old blocks and leaves a marker in the chain directory; the validators (src/infra/storage/chain-adapter.ts and crates/memphis-operator/src/chat_memory.rs) use the marker to PROVE that the live chain continues the archived prefix instead of starting at genesis. Without the marker a chain whose first live block is not index 0 or 1 is rejected as 'missing genesis block'. Both arms read THIS file, so the two validators cannot drift apart. The arms are tests/unit/chain-rotation-head-contract.test.ts and crates/memphis-operator/tests/chain_rotation_head_contract.rs.

cases.name: a live chain that continues the archived prefix verifies
a live block whose prev_hash does not match the archived head is rejected
a live block that skips a block after the archived head is rejected
no marker at all means the chain has to start at genesis
a chain that starts at genesis needs no marker
